content:
moving away from exalts being something that gets spammed every turn is clearly an intended design direction for the game currently, and not all the characters with the increased exalt costs interact with those increased costs in the same way.
some have convenient aliemus generation and instead have their exalts limited by other factors of their kit like glotan and arachne, some position their exalt as something with value that extend past a single fight and is thus planned to be budgeted throughout an entire exploration like saya (with an option to turbocharge its gain in her rouse incase you want it to take a more central role), and some are designed as a problem to be solved externally in the case of caraboo.

一个和平的夜晚，本打算在校园里闲逛至困意袭来的你，莫名被拉蒙娜逮住、不由分说地带到了一间废弃的办公室。

It was supposed to be a quiet night. You were simply wandering the hallways, waiting for drowsiness to set in, when Ramona suddenly ambushed you. Without a single word of explanation, she dragged you into an abandoned office.

*"All suspects are present. Please begin your statements."*

It suddenly dawns on you: you’ve been dragged right into the center of a bizarre crime scene! Can you use the clue board below to crack the case, identify the true culprit, and prove your innocence?

——✦——✦—— ✦✦✦ ——✦——✦——

**V2.6.0 백만 금권 도난 사건**
